# AlphaPulse-402 — Quantitative Alpha & Wash-Trade Detection Node on Base L2

> Ultra-Low-Cost Remote MCP & x402 Quantitative Alpha Node on Base ($0.004–$0.005 USDC, Zero API Keys): Real-time DEX wash-trade detector, smart-money inflow velocity radar, and LP impermanent loss guard with ready-to-use Coinbase AgentKit, ElizaOS, and Claude/Cursor plugins.

## Base URL & Payment Settlement
- Live Endpoint: <YOUR_VERCEL_URL>
- Remote MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0, 2024-11-05): <YOUR_VERCEL_URL>/mcp
- Health & Live RPC Status: <YOUR_VERCEL_URL>/api/v1/health
- Network: Base Mainnet (chainId: 8453)
- Asset: USDC (`0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`)
- PayTo Wallet: `0x6137ED1A93c8CFF1a6C3112A14bE04883f58E5F7`
- Payment Header: `X-Payment-Tx: <0x_base_tx_hash>` (stateless 600s anti-replay window)
- Free Preview: Append `?demo=true` (edge-cached 60s)

## Paid Endpoints
1. `GET /api/v1/wash-trade-detector` — **0.004 USDC** (`4000` base units)
   - Query: `?pair=0x...` or `?token=0x...` (or `?demo=true`)
   - Output: `organicVolumeScore` (0-100), `ORGANIC_DEMAND` vs `BOT_WASH_TRAP`, buy/sell symmetry, volume-to-liquidity ratio, Base RPC log entropy.
2. `GET /api/v1/smart-money-velocity` — **0.005 USDC** (`5000` base units)
   - Query: `?pair=0x...` or `?token=0x...` (or `?demo=true`)
   - Output: `pressureAcceleration`, `whaleNetInflowUsdPerMin`, `exhaustionIndex`, verdict (`ENTER_MOMENTUM`, `HOLD_TREND`, `TAKE_PROFIT_EXHAUSTION`).
3. `GET /api/v1/lp-impermanent-loss-guard` — **0.004 USDC** (`4000` base units)
   - Query: `?pair=0x...` or `?token=0x...&feeBps=30` (or `?demo=true`)
   - Output: `estimatedFeeAprPct`, `effectiveClIl24hPct`, `netLpYieldAprPct`, verdict (`FARM_FEES` vs `EXIT_LP_NOW`).
